name: Mie Phase Function Lookup
definition: A technique for rendering clouds using the Mie phase function, which models the anisotropic scattering of light by microscopic water droplets, characterized by a strong forward peak (silver lining) and diffraction/interference effects.
summary: Mie Phase Function Lookup is a real-time volume rendering technique that precomputes Mie scattering into a 1D texture to preserve specific diffraction features while avoiding the high cost of analytical calculation.
